decision.observation: Commons still swarm me at point-blank: a female common lunging center-left, a shirtless male close behind, another infected at right; the axe is raised; '<not bound>' heal prompt; health +7 (red).
decision.hypothesis: Axe swings land but the pack is too dense to clear from a standstill; backing away while swinging (kiting) reduces hits taken and keeps targets in the sweep arc.
decision.memory: Kiting (backing off while swinging) has survived hordes before; at +7 HP any hit is deadly.
